description: This file defines a FastAPI middleware class 'PrometheusAuthMiddleware' that authenticates requests to a metrics endpoint (typically '/metrics') by optionally verifying an API key before allowing access. It controls whether authentication is applied based on configuration settings and handles exceptions to ensure unauthorized requests are rejected with a 401 response.

classes.name: PrometheusAuthMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class that intercepts incoming requests, checks if they are aimed at the metrics endpoint, and enforces API key authentication when enabled via configuration.

methods.name: dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next)
methods.description: Main middleware handler that intercepts requests, verifies if they target '/metrics', optionally performs API key authentication, and processes the request or returns an error response.

methods.name: _is_prometheus_metrics_endpoint(request: Request)
methods.description: Static method that determines if the incoming request URL path is the metrics endpoint ('/metrics').

methods.name: _should_run_auth_on_metrics_endpoint()
methods.description: Static method that checks configuration to see if authentication should be enforced on the metrics endpoint.

ctags.name: dispatch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):$/
